title: Trigger Fire
description: Durable outbox row representing a trigger fire owed an invocation.

fire_id.description: Stable trigger fire outbox row identifier.

trigger_id.description: Trigger definition that produced this fire.

dedupe_key.description: Provider event id or computed idempotency key, unique per trigger over the sliding dedupe window.

priority.description: Priority lane: interactive, triggered, or retry.

shadow.description: Whether this fire was admitted in shadow mode; shadow fires record intent and never execute effects.

available_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when this fire becomes claimable.

payload.description: Normalized inbound event payload admitted by the trigger.

root_event_id.description: Root event identifier for cross-fire lineage and trigger-chain correlation.

parent_session_id.description: Optional parent session identifier for chained or nested invocations.

parent_trigger_id.description: Optional parent trigger identifier for chained trigger invocations.

trigger_chain_depth.description: Depth of the trigger chain used for amplification guards and trace correlation.
